name: Long-Horizon Calibration
motto: Name the stubs. Invent no incidents.
function: Shadow typed stub for long-horizon validation / calibration. Accepts forecastLifecycles, forecastScores, and horizonSpec. Emits CalibrationReport / PerformanceDrift / HorizonMetrics or nulls plus NOT_COMPUTABLE. Placeholder types stay NOT_COMPUTABLE. Does not implement FORECAST_SCORE, activate live Forecast scoring, invent calibration incidents, or mutate Forecast weights.
constraints: Code-bind override of Drift stub ACTIVE/BOUNDED
Placeholder types ForecastLifecycle, ForecastScore, HorizonSpec, CalibrationReport, PerformanceDrift, HorizonMetrics stay NOT_COMPUTABLE
Declared deps FORECAST_SCORE, CONTINUITY, ERS are unbound
Weak or missing inputs yield nulls plus NOT_COMPUTABLE / metric_not_computable / missing_resolution_data / horizon_mismatch
Deterministic: metrics recomputable from emitted artifacts only; same artifacts → same metrics
canonical_statement: RUNE.CALIBRATION (CAL) is a Shadow typed stub. It accepts forecastLifecycles, forecastScores, and horizonSpec, emits null-safe CalibrationReportStub / PerformanceDriftStub / HorizonMetricsStub or nulls with NOT_COMPUTABLE / metric_not_computable / missing_resolution_data / horizon_mismatch, and does not activate live Forecast scoring, invent calibration incidents, implement FORECAST_SCORE, or influence Forecast.

metadata.determinism_rule: metrics must be recomputable from emitted artifacts only; same artifacts → same metrics
